fluff.overview: Lyran military budgets translate directly into infantry equipment quality, giving LCAF conventional forces a material edge that compensates for the uneven tactical leadership the social general tradition sometimes produces. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Equipped with laser rifles for ranged engagement and needler pistols as sidearms, these platoons carry energy weapons suited to the confined spaces and zero-gravity conditions of shipboard combat. These marines are trained to fight equally well in zero-gravity and conventional ground environments, conducting shipboard security, boarding actions, and combat in vacuum or pressurized hull conditions.
